};
// src/application.ts
import type { AdminAccess, AgendaAccess, CatalogueAccess, Cleanup, DueWork, ExtractionAccess, FamilyMemberAccess, LanguageAccess, LlmEndpointAccess, MessageAccess, RecoveryKitAccess, Retention, SecretStore, SecretSweep, ServiceSupervision, SingleSignOn, SourceAccess, SourcePolling, SourceTypeAccess, TaskAccess } from "@family-agenda/application";

    secretSweep: SecretSweep;
    retention: Retention;
    recoveryKit: RecoveryKitAccess;
    familyMembers: FamilyMemberAccess;
    languages: LanguageAccess;
    agendas: AgendaAccess;

    services: ServiceSupervision;
    llmEndpoint: LlmEndpointAccess;
    singleSignOn: SingleSignOn;
    extraction: ExtractionAccess;
    dueWork: DueWork;
    cleanup: Cleanup;
    messages: MessageAccess;
    close(): Promise<void>;
};

// src/worker-loop.ts
import type { DueWorkReport } from "@family-agenda/application";
import type { Worker } from "./boot";
export type WorkerLog = {
    warn(message: string): void;
    error(message: string, error?: unknown): void;
};
export declare function logDueWorkReport(report: DueWorkReport, log: WorkerLog): void;
export type WorkerLoop = {
    reconcile(): Promise<void>;
    stop(): Promise<void>;
};
export declare function createWorkerLoop(worker: Worker, log: WorkerLog): WorkerLoop;
// src/source-registry.ts
import type { InstalledSourceType, LoadedSourceType, PlainConfig, SourceTypeRegistry } from "@family-agenda/application";
import type { SourceTypeId } from "@family-agenda/domain";
import { type PluginHostConfig } from "./plugin-host-client";
export declare class SourceRegistry implements SourceTypeRegistry {
    private readonly discovered;
    private readonly host;
    private readonly plugins;
    private readonly loaded;
    private readonly loadFailures;
    private constructor();
    static discover(directories: string[], options?: {
        pluginHost?: PluginHostConfig | null;
    }): Promise<SourceRegistry>;
    installed(): InstalledSourceType[];
    load(id: SourceTypeId): Promise<{
        ok: true;
        sourceType: LoadedSourceType;
    } | {
        ok: false;
    }>;
    migrateConfig(id: SourceTypeId, plain: PlainConfig, fromVersion: number): Promise<{
        ok: true;
        plain: PlainConfig;
        configVersion: number;
    } | {
        ok: false;
    }>;
    private pluginOf;
    private import;
}
// src/plugin-host-client.ts
import { type JsonObject, type SourcePlugin } from "@family-agenda/source-sdk";
export type PluginHostConfig = {
    url: string;
    token: string;
    sourceTypes: string[];
    fetch?: typeof globalThis.fetch;
};
export type HostedPlugin = {
    plugin: SourcePlugin;
    migrate(fromVersion: number, plain: JsonObject): Promise<JsonObject>;
};
export declare function bundlePlugin(entry: string): Promise<string>;
export declare class PluginHostClient {
    private readonly config;
    private readonly fetch;
    constructor(config: Omit<PluginHostConfig, "sourceTypes">);
    hosted(id: string, bundle: string): Promise<HostedPlugin>;
    private install;
    private call;
    private request;
}
